messages:
maria: Follow-up to the postmortem: outlining owners and concrete checkpoints for streaming partials/timeouts. Keeping this thread as the single source for follow-ups.
sre-bot: Incident 2167993200 summary: elevated partial responses + client reconnect storms 01:05-01:27 UTC. Rollback to previous runtime.
devon: I'll pick up reconnect algorithm changes and the client opt-in flag. Plan to put a PR w/ benchmarks by Thu EOD.
ajohnson: I'll coordinate SDK changes to expose ack watermark and reconnectWindowMs. Will keep interface backward compatible. PR Wed.
esteban: Server heartbeat adjustments + session TTL enforcement. I'll add a circuit-breaker so sessions don't get reaped aggressively. Need to define acceptable extra memory usage.
priya: I'll own QA harness scenarios: 1) 1% packet loss for 30s, 2) 200ms median latency spike, 3) rapid open/close loops. Want to run 2000 synthetic sessions per scenario. ETA Thu.
kevin: Observability plan: add metric streaming.partial_chunks_total and streaming.reconnects_per_min with tags for model_id and region. Dashboards + alerts. Proposed alert: partial_chunks_total rate > 1.2% for 10m OR reconnects_per_min > 50 sustained 5m.
maria: Good. Can we add a short-term client-side mitigation flag to throttle reconnect attempts server-side if reconnects_per_min > threshold? devon/kevin to discuss.
devon: Agreed. I'll add server-side token bucket to allow a burst of reconnects then enforce a soft holdoff. Sample pseudocode:
```
let lastAttempt = {};
function allowReconnect(clientId) {
  // token bucket per clientId
  return tokens[clientId] > 0;
}
```
I'll include a config to tune burst and refill rate.
esteban: On the server, I'll also add a lightweight probe that requires clients to ack a small ping frame within 500ms to keep session alive. This should reduce half-open streams.
ajohnson: SDK change: expose reconnectWindowMs default 15000 and reconnectFactor linear backoff of 2s increments up to 30s. Example: attempts => Math.min(2000 * attempt, 30000).
priya: Tests: I'll script flaky-network runs and verify two things: no more than 0.5% duplicate chunk deliveries, and successful reconnection without data loss in 99% of sessions.
kevin: For rollout, propose small canary: 2% traffic for 4h -> 10% for 6h -> 50% for 12h -> 100%. Rollback on partial_chunks_total not improving by >=70% or latency regression >7% p95.
maria: Owners recap: reconnect algo + server token-bucket: devon (Thu); server heartbeat + probe: esteban (Fri); SDKs: ajohnson (Wed); QA harness: priya (Thu); metrics/alerts + dashboards: kevin (Mon). I will link Jira tickets after this thread.
devon: Will also add unit test for chunk dedup watermarking and an integration test that verifies KV cache reuse across reconnects.
esteban: Note: we keep seeing small cluster-wide periodic blips every 25 days tied to batchhouse compaction job. I'll instrument batch_job_id in streaming logs to correlate.
kevin: I'll create a short runbook snippet for on-call: 1) check partial_chunks_total, 2) query reconnects_per_min by client_id, 3) toggle canary backoff holdoff if needed.
maria: Let's set check-ins: daily standup sync for 10 days, then twice-weekly for next 2 weeks. First sync tomorrow 9:30 PT. I'll send calendar invite.
ajohnson: QA acceptance: 1) partial_chunks_total drop >=70% in canary; 2) no duplicate chunk >0.5%; 3) SDKs maintain existing API.
priya: Running tests now will take about 6 hours. Will post results into this thread and the linked ticket.
deploy-bot: Incident summary and follow-ups will be archived after jira/PR links are attached.
maria: OK. I'll create the Jira and link everything here. If any scope creep, call it out before PRs land. Keep updates in this thread only so we have traceable ownership history.
